stories.title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
stories.simple_summary: A company called Relay that worked on AI automation is closing down, and its team is moving to work on AI features in Google's Chrome browser.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech workers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon, which started off selling books, is destroying rare texts to train AI
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is destroying rare and valuable old books to use them for training AI systems (machine learning). These old books are useful because AI has already learned from most things available on the internet.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own rare or antique books, know that they may become less available and more expensive in the future.

stories.title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
stories.simple_summary: A company called Groq received $350 million in funding and is changing its business from making AI computer chips to offering cloud computing services (renting computer power over the internet).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large businesses — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
stories.simple_summary: Computer chip maker Nvidia is investing $1.5 billion in a company that builds data centers (massive computer warehouses), which will power AI systems made by OpenAI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Wispr raises $280M at $2B valuation as it looks beyond dictation
stories.simple_summary: A voice recording company called Wispr received $280 million to expand and add new features, like taking notes during meetings automatically.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have lots of meetings, this company's new note-taking tool might eventually save you time by recording and summarizing what was said.

stories.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
stories.simple_summary: The AI company Anthropic is adding invisible digital fingerprints to text created by their AI assistant Claude so people can tell that text was AI-generated, following European rules.
stories.why_it_matters: This helps ensure AI-written content is clearly labeled, which protects you from being tricked by machine-written material pretending to be human-written.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly disbanded its preparedness team
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI closed down its safety team that was supposed to check if AI systems could cause serious problems or go rogue.
stories.why_it_matters: This is concerning because it means fewer people are watching for AI risks, though the long-term impact remains unclear.

stories.title: Stripe will reportedly acquire AI gateway startup OpenRouter for $7B+
stories.simple_summary: Payment company Stripe is reportedly buying an AI startup called OpenRouter for over $7 billion; OpenRouter works kind of like Stripe does but for AI services.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Why people aren’t buying Mark Zuckerberg’s AI future
stories.simple_summary: Mark Zuckerberg (Facebook's founder) has been promoting his vision for AI's future, but many people are skeptical and not convinced by his ideas.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly tech industry discussion — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO says AI backlash is ‘fundamentally a crisis of trust’
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Anthropic says that people's doubts about AI come from not trusting the companies making it, not from realistic concerns about AI being bad.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly industry talk between executives — it reflects the debate about whether AI companies are being honest with the public.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s Computer History tracks your clicks and keystrokes
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT's desktop app now has a feature called Computer History that watches what you click and type on your computer to learn your habits and suggest shortcuts.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use this feature, know that ChatGPT will be recording and learning from everything you do on your computer — make sure you're comfortable with that before turning it on.

stories.title: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
stories.simple_summary: AI systems that can act on their own without a human controlling them are now real, not just science fiction.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a developing story about AI safety that affects how careful companies should be — it's worth watching but the details aren't clear yet.
